scripts.watch: npm run generate-proto && ng build --watch --configuration development
scripts.// note: protobufjs-cli@2 conflict with protobufjs@8. Use npm i --legacy-peer-deps. This is patched in https://github.com/protobufjs/protobuf.js/pull/2118 but not yet released as of 2026-02-08.
scripts.generate-proto: pbjs -t static-module -w es6 --es6 -o src/app/core/proto/bundle.js ../proto/src/main/proto/common.proto ../proto/src/main/proto/page.proto ../proto/src/main/proto/block.proto ../proto/src/main/proto/search.proto ../proto/src/main/proto/api.proto && pbts -o src/app/core/proto/bundle.d.ts src/app/core/proto/bundle.js
